d: Hitachi, Ltd. is seeking a talented Electrical Engineer to contribute to the design, development, and testing of innovative electrical systems and components. This role involves applying electrical engineering principles to create robust and efficient solutions across various Hitachi product lines.
q: Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering or a related field.
Experience in electrical design and development, preferably in a relevant industry (e.g., power systems, industrial automation, automotive, electronics).
Strong understanding of electrical engineering fundamentals, including circuit theory, electromagnetics, and control systems.
Proficiency with electrical CAD software (e.g., Altium Designer, OrCAD, Eagle) for schematic capture and PCB layout.
Experience with simulation tools (e.g., SPICE, MATLAB/Simulink).
Familiarity with various electrical components, sensors, and actuators.
Knowledge of safety standards (e.g., UL, CE) and regulatory requirements.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively.

r: Design, simulate, and analyze electrical circuits, power systems, and control systems for new and existing products.
Develop detailed electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and component specifications.
Perform calculations and simulations to ensure system performance, reliability, and safety.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including mechanical engineers, software engineers, and project managers throughout the product lifecycle.
Conduct testing, debugging, and validation of electrical hardware and integrated systems.
Troubleshoot and resolve electrical issues during development, production, and field deployment.
Research and evaluate new technologies, components, and methodologies to enhance product capabilities.
Prepare technical documentation, including design specifications, test plans, and reports.
Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and safety regulations.

d: Leading, Managing, and overseeing all the fit out works, refurbishments and renovations, as well as new branch & office projects for ADIB premises as per the highest standard designs and develop the fit-out work within the highest level of quality in cost effective and timely manner as per ADIB policy and procedures.
q: Project management including knowledge of different project management methodologies
Strong knowledge of construction materials, finishes, and MEP systems.
Experience in managing multiple projects simultaneously.
Effective interpersonal skills at all levels
Technical knowledge of UAE building regulations / safety requirements
Bachelor’s degree in engineering: Civil engineer, Architecture,
At least 3 years plus experience in a similar role with project management and coordination of full execution of fit out projects.
r: Responsible for the successful initiation, planning, design, execution, monitoring, controlling and closure of an ADIB Project.

Plan, budget, oversee and document all aspects of the required ADIB project to ensure that the project cycle- Initiation, Planning, Execution and Closure- is completed and meeting agreed project parameters (budget, timelines and scope/quality), standards and objectives.
Work closely with upper management to ensure comprehensive scope meets business requirements and enables the ADIB business to deliver their targets.

Assist in Managing the continuous improvement of department practices considering ‘international best practice’, changes in international standards and changes in the business environment which demand proactive action plans.
Ensure all fit out work aligns with ADIB’s design standards and branding guidelines through close collaboration with all stakeholders, including Marketing Team.
Evaluate and selector fit out / construction contractors as per the ADIB Procurement Policy through full technical evaluation.
Oversee and monitor contractor performance to ensure for timely project delivery as per contractual terms for Quality- Cost- and time delivery.
Ensure all fit out work comply with local UAE building codes, safety regulations and environmental requirements.
Ensure all local legal legislation for construction and safety are met.
Liaise with all ADIB internal departments to ensure project delivery time: ITD- Security- Marketing and other- stakeholders for seamless project execution.
Prepare cost estimates and manage projects cost effectively.
Identify cost saving opportunities without compromising on quality & safety.
Ensure all expenses are accounted- documented- reports and controlled.
Incorporation of sustainability materials into the fit out and construction.
Preparing project updates on the progress status according to the originally approved project costs and timeliness to monitor project deliverables as planned.
Prepare and submit weekly and monthly reports as per progress at sites.
Remain up to date with knowledge of suppliers in market / market values / trends in engineering / new materials.
